name: table-empty-state-premium
title: Upgrade empty table-management setup state
description: Keep the React-owned table empty state visually polished without injecting DOM into the populated table grid.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The regression came from a MutationObserver inserting onboarding nodes into DOM owned by React. During the transition from no floors to populated tables, those nodes could survive and become children of the table grid, squeezing cards and breaking the layout. The installer now only removes stale HMR nodes/listeners and never observes or injects DOM. Empty-state polish is CSS-only and scoped to the existing React-rendered .tm-empty element. A focused test verifies legacy nodes are removed while table cards remain untouched. Tests/build were not executed in the connected environment.
